pack.name: AKS Production Baseline
pack.description: Kubernetes on Azure production hardening themes (private API, network policy, identity).

rules.title: Private AKS API server endpoint
rules.description: Production clusters must document private API server access — not public internet exposure for control plane.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record private cluster setting in governance.RequiredControls; verify apiServerAccessProfile in azureExtractor AKS inventory.

rules.title: Authorized IP ranges if API not fully private
rules.description: When API server remains partially public, approved IP ranges must be documented with break-glass exception process.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document authorized IP ranges in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Azure CNI with network policy enabled
rules.description: Pod-to-pod traffic must document Calico or Azure network policy for east-west segmentation.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag networkPolicy on services[].Tags; cite networkPolicy plugin from azureExtractor AKS properties.

rules.title: Workload identity or managed identity for pods
rules.description: Applications must use workload identity federation — not service principal secrets in Kubernetes secrets.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document workload identity in governance.RequiredControls and services[].Tags for AKS workloads.

rules.title: RBAC enabled with Azure AD integration
rules.description: Kubernetes RBAC must integrate with Entra ID groups — not local cluster-admin accounts for routine ops.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture AAD-integrated RBAC in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Least-privilege namespace isolation
rules.description: Namespaces must document resource quotas, network policies, and RBAC boundaries per team or workload.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe namespace isolation in metadata.ChangeDescription and services[].Tags.

rules.title: Container image from trusted registry
rules.description: Images must pull from approved ACR or registry with vulnerability scanning — not unvetted public images in prod.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag image source on services[].Tags; document ACR linkage in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Image vulnerability scanning gate
rules.description: CI/CD must block deployment of images with critical CVEs unless documented exception with expiry.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe image scan gates in governance.RequiredControls and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Pod security standards enforced
rules.description: Clusters must document Pod Security Admission or policy (OPA/Gatekeeper) restricting privileged containers.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record pod security level in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Secrets via Key Vault CSI driver
rules.description: Application secrets should use Key Vault provider — not plain Kubernetes secrets for long-lived credentials.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document secret injection pattern in governance.RequiredControls and services[].Tags.

rules.title: etcd encryption at rest
rules.description: AKS control plane etcd encryption must be documented (platform-managed or CMK where supported).
rules.remediationGuidance: Note etcd encryption in governance.PolicyConstraints; align with azureExtractor cluster security profile.

rules.title: Node pool autoscaling documented
rules.description: Cluster capacity must document cluster autoscaler limits, node SKU, and zone spread.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture autoscale bounds in governance.PolicyConstraints and services[].Tags.

rules.title: Availability zone spread for node pools
rules.description: Production node pools should span multiple AZs for worker failure tolerance.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag zonal node pools in services[].Tags; verify availabilityZones in azureExtractor agent pool profile.

rules.title: Ingress with WAF protection
rules.description: Public ingress controllers must sit behind WAF (App Gateway, Front Door) with TLS termination documented.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document ingress/WAF chain in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Internal load balancers for east-west only
rules.description: Services not requiring public access must use internal load balancers or mesh ingress — not public LB by default.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag internal-only services in services[].Tags and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Diagnostic logs to Log Analytics
rules.description: AKS control plane and container insights must route logs to centralized analytics with retention stated.
rules.remediationGuidance: List log destinations in governance.RequiredControls; align with azureExtractor diagnostic settings.

rules.title: Azure Monitor container insights enabled
rules.description: Metrics and logs for pods/nodes must document Container Insights or equivalent Prometheus/Grafana stack.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag observability stack in services[].Tags and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Defender for Containers enabled
rules.description: Runtime threat detection for Kubernetes should be documented (Defender, Falco, or approved equivalent).
rules.remediationGuidance: Record runtime protection in governance.ComplianceTags and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Upgrade channel and patch cadence
rules.description: Kubernetes version upgrades must document channel (stable, rapid), maintenance windows, and rollback plan.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe upgrade policy in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Resource limits and requests on workloads
rules.description: All production deployments must document CPU/memory requests and limits preventing noisy-neighbor exhaustion.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note resource governance in governance.RequiredControls and services[].Tags.

rules.title: Disallow hostPath and privileged mounts
rules.description: Workloads must not require hostPath or privileged mode unless documented exception with risk acceptance.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document exceptions in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Service mesh mTLS (optional but documented)
rules.description: When service mesh is used, mTLS mode and identity federation must be documented for east-west traffic.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe mesh mTLS in metadata.ChangeDescription and services[].Tags if Istio/Linkerd present.

rules.title: Backup for stateful workloads
rules.description: StatefulSets and PVCs must document Velero or Azure Backup snapshot strategy with restore testing.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag stateful backup approach on datastores[].Tags and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Outbound traffic control (UDR or firewall)
rules.description: Egress from cluster should document Azure Firewall, NAT gateway, or UDR filtering — not unrestricted outbound.
rules.remediationGuidance: Map egress controls in metadata.ChangeDescription; align with azureExtractor route tables.

rules.title: GitOps or approved deployment pipeline
rules.description: Cluster changes must flow through GitOps (Flux/Argo) or approved pipeline — not kubectl apply from laptops.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document GitOps/deployment pipeline in governance.RequiredControls and services[].Tags.

rules.title: Disaster recovery cluster documented
rules.description: Multi-region or backup cluster strategy must be stated for tier-1 workloads on AKS.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe AKS DR topology in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Cost and quota guardrails
rules.description: Cluster must document max node count, spot vs on-demand mix, and subscription quota headroom.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note capacity guardrails in governance.ComplianceTags and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Break-glass cluster admin access
rules.description: Emergency cluster admin access must be time-bound, logged, and reviewed — not standing clusterAdmin for all ops.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record break-glass process in governance.RequiredControls and metadata.ChangeDescription.
